# Plexus RPC

> A Rust RPC framework. A service is a tree of activations; each method returns a stream. The command line (synapse) and the TypeScript client (synapse-cc) are generated from the service's own schema.

- [plexus-rpc on crates.io](https://crates.io/crates/plexus-rpc): the one dependency a service takes
- [API reference](https://docs.rs/plexus-rpc)
- [Source](https://github.com/hypermemetic-ai/plexus-rpc)

## A service

Cargo.toml:

```toml
[package]
name = "myservice"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
plexus-rpc = "0.11"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["macros", "rt-multi-thread"] }
futures = "0.3"
anyhow = "1"
```

src/main.rs:

```rust
use std::sync::Arc;
use plexus_rpc::prelude::*;

#[derive(Debug, PlexusWire)]
pub enum CountEvent {
    Tick { n: u32 },
}

#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub struct EchoActivation;

/// Say things back.
#[activation]
impl EchoActivation {
    /// Ticks from 1 up to `to`.
    #[method]
    pub async fn count(
        &self,
        /// the last tick
        to: u32,
    ) -> impl Stream<Item = CountEvent> + Send + 'static {
        futures::stream::iter((1..=to).map(|n| CountEvent::Tick { n }))
    }
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    let service = Arc::new(DynamicService::new("myservice").register(EchoActivation));
    TransportServer::builder(service, |s| DynamicService::arc_into_rpc_module(s).map_err(Into::into))
        .with_websocket(4444)
        .build()
        .await?
        .serve()
        .await
}
```

## Calling it

```sh
cargo run
synapse myservice echo count --to 3
```
